name: Brand rules
observations: Language: Uzbek (latin) for all content and replies, unless the owner asks for Russian
Edits are 45 seconds max; cut every pause longer than half a second
No filler words (eee, mmm, um) in the edit or the captions
Captions: 3 words per line, the spoken word highlighted in yellow #FFD400
Cover text: 3 words max, all caps, the last word in yellow #FFD400
Story text: 8 to 12 words max per story, big and readable on a phone
Titles and first lines: plain and specific, no clickbait, no false promises
Voice: direct, friendly and trustworthy; plain words, short sentences
Never invent prices, dates or numbers for a client; unsure facts are marked [tekshiring]
